backbone: POWO / World Checklist of Vascular Plants 2026
secondary_authority: IPNI 2026 for Eragrostis tenuis A.Gray publication; Flora of North America 2003 as cited by POWO
native_range_audit: DEFERRED — county nativity and metrics untouched
specimen_identity: HOLD — no individual source-photo or voucher certification
hybrid_provenance: HOLD — no unsupported hybrid or cultivated ancestry assignment
install_decision: No species installation or alias injection; taxonomy evidence only

decisions.subject: Eragrostis hirsuta (Michx.) Nees (1829)
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain as an accepted Poaceae species with authorship (Michx.) Nees; canonical learner is correctly named.
decisions.detail: Separate species from E. trichodes and E. spectabilis; no canonical edit.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis trichodes (Nutt.) Alph.Wood (1861)
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain as an accepted Poaceae species with authorship (Nutt.) Alph.Wood; canonical learner is correctly named.
decisions.detail: Not a synonym of E. hirsuta; no canonical edit.

decisions.subject: Poa hirsuta Michx. (1803)
decisions.proposed_decision: Record as homotypic basionym of Eragrostis hirsuta (Michx.) Nees.
decisions.detail: Authorship is critical because other historical Poa hirsuta combinations can point elsewhere.

decisions.subject: Poa trichodes Nutt. (1835)
decisions.proposed_decision: Record as homotypic basionym of Eragrostis trichodes (Nutt.) Alph.Wood.
decisions.detail: Do not create Poa learner duplicate.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis hirsuta var. laevivaginata Fernald (1939)
decisions.proposed_decision: Record as heterotypic synonym of E. hirsuta under current POWO/WCVP.
decisions.detail: Not a currently accepted separate variety.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis sporoboloides J.G.Sm. & Bush (1895)
decisions.proposed_decision: Record as heterotypic synonym of E. hirsuta.
decisions.detail: No additional learner card.

decisions.subject: Poa simplex Walter (1788)
decisions.proposed_decision: Record as heterotypic synonym of E. hirsuta.
decisions.detail: Original Poa name is not an accepted independent species.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis capillacea Jedwabn. (1924)
decisions.proposed_decision: Record as heterotypic synonym of E. trichodes.
decisions.detail: Do not confuse with independently accepted E. capillaris.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis grandiflora J.G.Sm. & Bush (1895)
decisions.proposed_decision: Record as heterotypic synonym of E. trichodes.
decisions.detail: Retain author-qualified synonym.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis pilifera Scheele (1849)
decisions.proposed_decision: Record as heterotypic synonym of E. trichodes.
decisions.detail: Do not create a separate pilifera species.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis tenuis A.Gray (1890)
decisions.proposed_decision: Record as illegitimate later homonym and heterotypic synonym of E. trichodes; do not use as accepted name.
decisions.detail: Nomenclatural illegitimacy is distinct from invalid publication.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis tenuis var. texensis Vasey (1890)
decisions.proposed_decision: Record as heterotypic synonym of E. trichodes.
decisions.detail: Rank and author must be retained.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis trichodes var. pilifera (Scheele) Fernald (1938)
decisions.proposed_decision: Record as heterotypic synonym of E. trichodes, not a currently accepted variety.
decisions.detail: No separate variety card.

decisions.subject: Poa hirsuta var. spectabilis (Pursh) Torr. (1823)
decisions.rank: variety / homotypic synonym of E. spectabilis
decisions.proposed_decision: Resolve to accepted Eragrostis spectabilis (Pursh) Steud., not to E. hirsuta.
decisions.detail: Historical parent name Poa hirsuta does not determine the current accepted species.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis spectabilis (Pursh) Steud. (1840)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as a third distinct accepted Eragrostis species for historical Poa hirsuta var. spectabilis mapping.
decisions.detail: Already treated in a separate prior taxonomy evidence batch; no new card or edits.

decisions.subject: Collapse Eragrostis hirsuta and E. trichodes because both are open-panicle perennial lovegrasses
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject: POWO/WCVP accepts both separately; similar habit cannot substitute for taxon identity.
decisions.detail: No merge, reassignment of photos, or canonical rename.

decisions.subject: Automatically map Poa hirsuta var. spectabilis to Eragrostis hirsuta
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject: its accepted destination is E. spectabilis.
decisions.detail: Preserve original variety rank, epithet, authorship and type linkage.

decisions.subject: Treat Eragrostis tenuis A.Gray as a valid accepted name or an authorless universal alias
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject: A.Gray's 1890 name is an illegitimate later homonym mapped to E. trichodes; ambiguous authorless labels cannot be resolved automatically.
decisions.detail: Preserve exact authorship and nomenclatural status.

decisions.subject: Existing Eragrostis hirsuta and E. trichodes individual photographs/vouchers
decisions.proposed_decision: Do not certify individual specimens or move photographs between cards from taxonomy names alone.
decisions.detail: Sheath/collar hair distribution and reproductive structures require image or voucher-level validation by the responsible worker.

decisions.subject: Individual hybrid, introgression, or cultivated provenance for E. hirsuta and E. trichodes
decisions.proposed_decision: Do not assign hybrid parentage or cultivar pedigree without individual supporting voucher, genetic, or provenance evidence.
decisions.detail: This review establishes no named hybrid determination for the project specimens.

decisions.subject: Historical Poa hirsuta, Eragrostis tenuis, or pilifera labels missing author/rank/voucher
decisions.proposed_decision: Leave unassigned until full historical combination, authorship and specimen context are available.
decisions.detail: Shared epithets or parent binomials alone are insufficient for a confident modern destination.
